description: Amazon product reviews API for AI agents: send an ASIN or an Amazon product URL and get up to 50 customer reviews as JSON: rating, title, text, date, verified-purchase flag and helpful votes. Sort by recent or helpful, filter by stars, and pick the marketplace (US, UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, CA, JP). Reviewer names and photos are not returned. A product with no reviews is not charged.

country.description: Amazon marketplace of an ASIN (a URL sets its own; a different value is refused)

limit.description: number of reviews wanted, 1 to 50 (default 10). A larger value is lowered to 50 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

product.description: an ASIN (10 characters, e.g. B079JLY5M5) or an Amazon product URL (.../dp/ASIN) on amazon.com, .co.uk, .de, .fr, .it, .es, .ca or .co.jp; a URL sets the marketplace

stars.description: keep only reviews with this many stars (5 to 1), the positive ones (4 and 5) or the critical ones (1 to 3)

name: amazon-reviews
title: Amazon customer reviews of a product
